sequence_notes.rule: Veo's camera stays locked on every clip; Premiere does every push and pull, eased.
sequence_notes.why: Camera moves are what make Omni redraw a scene.

sequence_notes.rule: No speech from Flow. The narration (Achernar) and the nan's line (Vindemiatrix) are the AI Studio takes you picked; a talking clip is muted and dubbed.
Every word on screen (the flyer headline, the £3 text, the logo) is drawn by ffmpeg, never asked of Omni.
sequence_notes.why: Omni garbles readable text as it moves.

sequence_notes.rule: The motion prompts are written clean-room after you pick an option: a sealed writer gets the option's idea and the still, nothing from the repo.
Length: the narration is 19 s as recorded, about 13.5 s with its long pauses tightened (never sped up). With the nan's ending the short lands near 20 s.
sequence_notes.why: Shorts are 5-20 s; length is the joke.

frames.job: Sell the charity appeal straight-faced, so the joke is all in the words.

options.label: Slow-mo rain, one long hold
options.idea: Rain streams down the glass in slow motion; Crispin blinks slowly and lowers his gaze. One clip, played at about 60% speed to fill the narration.

lanes.does: Locked camera; rain runs down the pane, one slow blink, his hand stays on the glass.
Slowed to ~60% with frame blending; a very slow push in over the whole line.
Charity-advert text card at the end: '£3 a month'.

options.cut: Opens the short; hard cut to frame 2 after 'you can help.'
options.risk: Low. Slow-mo on an 8 s clip can stutter; a second chained clip is the fallback.

options.label: Two chained clips: hand slides down the glass
options.idea: Clip one: he looks out, rain running. Clip two (from clip one's last frame): his hand slides slowly down the pane, a single tear-like raindrop tracks beside his face. Real speed, no slow-mo.

lanes.does: Two 8 s clips chained last frame to first; locked camera.
Slow push in across both; cut at the join on 'Tonight'.
'£3 a month' card.

options.risk: Medium. The second clip may drift his face; the SAC Chancellor character keeps it close.

options.label: Hold the still, Premiere only
options.idea: No video credits: the still slowed to life by Premiere alone (push in plus a rain overlay), like a cheap appeal.

lanes.does: Slow push in on the still, a stock rain-on-glass overlay (free licence checked).

options.risk: Low cost; may read as a slideshow.

frames.job: The reveal: the advert was on her old telly, and she is freezing.

options.label: Telly flicker, her breath
options.idea: She sits still with the mug; the telly light flickers on her face and her breath shows in the cold.

lanes.does: Locked camera; flickering screen light, a faint breath cloud, steam off the mug.
The frame-1 advert placed into the telly screen (corner pin), so the cut reads as a pull back.

options.cut: Hard cut from the advert's last word.
options.risk: Low. Breath may not show; the steam carries it.

options.label: The letterbox clatters
options.idea: She turns her head toward the hallway as the letterbox clatters (sound only, off screen).

lanes.does: Locked camera; [00:00-00:01] still, [00:01-00:03] she turns her head toward the door.
Letterbox clatter (Freesound CC0).
Advert in the telly screen as in a.

options.cut: Cut to frame 3 on the head turn.

frames.job: The junk mail: the same man, now begging through her letterbox.

options.label: Post lands, hand reaches in
options.idea: Her hand comes into frame and picks up the flyer from the mat.

lanes.does: Locked camera; [00:01-00:03] a wrinkled hand reaches down and lifts the flyer out of frame.
Redraw the SPONSOR A CHANCELLOR band clean over the flyer if Omni smears it.

options.cut: Cut to frame 4 as the flyer leaves frame.
options.risk: Medium: the printed text will warp as it moves; ffmpeg patch or cut before the lift.

options.label: Still mat, a push in
options.idea: Nothing moves but a draught lifts a leaflet corner; Premiere pushes into Crispin's sad face on the flyer.

lanes.does: Locked camera; a draught lifts one leaflet corner.
Push in on the flyer photo.

options.label: She says it (lip-sync dub)
options.idea: She looks at the flyer, a small sad shake of the head, and says the line; the clip is muted and dubbed with Vindemiatrix's 'Poor bastard...'.

lanes.does: Locked camera; she shakes her head slightly and mouths the two words (muted after).
Measure the mouth, lay the dub late-never-early.
BadCode logo end card.

options.cut: Hold a beat after the line, cut to the logo.
options.risk: Medium: a lip-sync fit; one or two takes.

options.label: She sighs, the line over a held face
options.idea: Lips pressed together, she sighs and lowers the flyer; the line plays as she lowers it, mouth barely moving, under her breath.

lanes.does: Locked camera; a slow sigh, she lowers the flyer a little.
Logo end card.

options.risk: Low; no sync needed, since the take is under her breath.
